note_en: 又…又… links two qualities that are true at the same time: 嗓音又高又清澈 "his voice was both high and clear," 演唱会又有力又有激情 "his concerts are both powerful and passionate." Each 又 goes directly before its own adjective or verb phrase, so you can't simply say 又高和清澈. The text also uses the more formal 既…又… (既适合安静的情歌又适合有力的舞曲), which works the same way but suits longer, weightier phrases.
